name: Major Corruption
description: GM only. A Sorcerer's Wild Surge: the GM rolls d20 in secret, 1 is Major Corruption and 2 to 20 Minor, then d100 here (Monsters & Treasure, Sorcerer's Corruption). The Sorcerer's own save against its surge is DC 15; others use its spell DC.

results.name: Ageing
results.description: Ageing: you age 1d10 years in an instant. Your hair whitens and your features grow lined.

results.name: Make a Will save, DC 15, or turn into a harmless beast of...
results.description: Make a Will save, DC 15, or turn into a harmless beast of the GM's choice for 1 hour, as polymorph.

results.name: Teleport
results.description: Teleport: you vanish and reappear at a random unoccupied point within 1 mile, chosen by the GM.

results.name: A fireball bursts centred on you
results.description: A fireball bursts centred on you: everything within 20ft takes 1d6 fire damage per level of your spell. Reflex save for half (others use your spell DC; you, DC 15).

results.name: Withering
results.description: Withering: you permanently lose 1 point from a randomly chosen attribute.

results.name: Chaos aura
results.description: Chaos aura: for 1 minute, every spell you cast triggers a Corruption roll, as if you had used Wild Surge.

results.name: You are affected by blink for 1 minute and cannot end it...
results.description: You are affected by blink for 1 minute and cannot end it early.

results.name: Warped
results.description: Warped: part of you is permanently and visibly altered (scales, extra knuckles, a second pupil; the player and GM agree on the form). Disadvantage on Persuasion checks with strangers who notice it.

results.name: Haste settles on a random creature within 30ft, friend or...
results.description: Haste settles on a random creature within 30ft, friend or foe, for 1 minute.

results.name: Time drags at you
results.description: Time drags at you: you are Slowed for 1 minute, as slow, and cannot end it early.

results.name: Magical darkness fills a 15ft radius centred on you for 1...
results.description: Magical darkness fills a 15ft radius centred on you for 1 minute and moves with you.

results.name: You are affected by confusion for 1 minute
results.description: You are affected by confusion for 1 minute. Make a Will save, DC 15, at the end of each of your turns to end it.

results.name: Burnt out
results.description: Burnt out: you cannot cast spells of your highest available level for 1 day.

results.name: Stone creeps up your limbs
results.description: Stone creeps up your limbs: make a Fortitude save, DC 15, or be Petrified for 1 hour. On a success you are Restrained for 1 round.

results.name: Grease coats a 10ft square centred on you, and you fall...
results.description: Grease coats a 10ft square centred on you, and you fall Prone.

results.name: A fog cloud billows from your body, filling a 20ft radius...
results.description: A fog cloud billows from your body, filling a 20ft radius for 1 hour, and follows wherever you go.

results.name: You rise 30ft into the air as levitate for 1 minute and...
results.description: You rise 30ft into the air as levitate for 1 minute and cannot control your height. When it ends, you fall.

results.name: You grow to twice your size for 1 hour, as enlarge
results.description: You grow to twice your size for 1 hour, as enlarge. Your clothing and armour do not grow with you and tear free.

results.name: You shrink to a few inches tall for 1 hour, along with...
results.description: You shrink to a few inches tall for 1 hour, along with everything you carry.

results.name: Star crossed
results.description: Star crossed: you lose all your remaining Luck.

results.name: Hexed
results.description: Hexed: you are cursed with Disadvantage on one save of the GM's choice until remove curse ends it.

results.name: A tear to the Elemental Planes opens within 30ft for 1...
results.description: A tear to the Elemental Planes opens within 30ft for 1 minute; a hostile elemental of up to half your level steps through.

results.name: You fall upward as if gravity had reversed, up to 60ft or...
results.description: You fall upward as if gravity had reversed, up to 60ft or until you strike something, and hang there for 1 minute before falling back.

results.name: Youth
results.description: Youth: you grow 1d10 years younger, though no younger than a young adult. It is permanent.

results.name: Unravelling
results.description: Unravelling: you lose all unspent spell slots of your highest available level until your next full rest.

results.name: Up to three objects you carry come to life for 1 minute and...
results.description: Up to three objects you carry come to life for 1 minute and try to escape you.

results.name: Memory hole
results.description: Memory hole: you forget one spell you know, chosen at random, until your next full rest.

results.name: Your body turns half insubstantial for 1 hour
results.description: Your body turns half insubstantial for 1 hour: Resistance 10 to bludgeoning, piercing and slashing damage, but you cannot hold or wield anything.

results.name: A shockwave of force bursts from you
results.description: A shockwave of force bursts from you. You fall Prone; every creature within 15ft must make a Fortitude save against your spell DC or fall Prone too.

results.name: Lightning arcs to the nearest other creature within 30ft,...
results.description: Lightning arcs to the nearest other creature within 30ft, friend or foe: 1d6 lightning damage per level of your spell. Reflex save against your spell DC for half.

results.name: Drained
results.description: Drained: you gain 1 level of Exhaustion.

results.name: Chaos curdles in your blood
results.description: Chaos curdles in your blood: you are Poisoned for 1 hour.

results.name: A roaring void fills your ears
results.description: A roaring void fills your ears: you are Deafened for 1 day.

results.name: Your eyes burn white
results.description: Your eyes burn white: make a Fortitude save, DC 15, or be Blinded for 1 hour.

results.name: A wave of raw glamour
results.description: A wave of raw glamour: every creature within 30ft must make a Will save against your spell DC or be Charmed by you for 1 minute.

results.name: Visions of the Far Realm flood your mind
results.description: Visions of the Far Realm flood your mind: you are Frightened of every creature you can see for 1 minute.

results.name: You are dragged into the Shadowfell for 1 minute, then...
results.description: You are dragged into the Shadowfell for 1 minute, then returned to where you stood or the nearest free space.

results.name: Swap
results.description: Swap: you and a random creature within 60ft trade places.

results.name: Misfire
results.description: Misfire: your spell is replaced by a random spell of the same level, chosen by the GM, aimed at the same target.

results.name: Every mundane light within 60ft goes out, and no fire will...
results.description: Every mundane light within 60ft goes out, and no fire will kindle there for 1 hour.

results.name: You speak only a tongue no one knows for 1 day and cannot...
results.description: You speak only a tongue no one knows for 1 day and cannot understand any other. You can still cast spells.

results.name: Backlash
results.description: Backlash: you take 1d6 force damage per level of the spell you cast (minimum 1d6).

results.name: A swarm of shrieking bats pours from your mouth, filling a...
results.description: A swarm of shrieking bats pours from your mouth, filling a 20ft radius for 1 minute. Creatures inside have Disadvantage on Perception checks.

results.name: Roots of raw power grip your feet
results.description: Roots of raw power grip your feet: you are Restrained for 1 minute.

results.name: Branded
results.description: Branded: a rune of chaos burns permanently into your brow. Any creature that can sense magic knows you are a spellcaster.

results.name: Magic hunger
results.description: Magic hunger: until your next full rest, you cannot regain HP except by magic.

results.name: You turn Invisible for 1 day and cannot end it early
results.description: You turn Invisible for 1 day and cannot end it early. Unable to see your own hands, you have Disadvantage on Pick Pocket checks.

results.name: Raw life floods out
results.description: Raw life floods out: you and every creature within 30ft regain 1d8 HP per level of your spell.

results.name: Your maximum HP is reduced by 1d10 until your next full rest
results.description: Your maximum HP is reduced by 1d10 until your next full rest.

results.name: A hostile duplicate of you, woven from raw magic, appears...
results.description: A hostile duplicate of you, woven from raw magic, appears within 30ft for 1 minute. It has your statistics but half your HP.

results.name: The surge overwhelms you
results.description: The surge overwhelms you: make a Fortitude save, DC 15, or fall Unconscious for 1 minute. Taking damage wakes you.

results.name: Your eyes become pools of swirling colour, permanently
results.description: Your eyes become pools of swirling colour, permanently. You gain darkvision to 60ft but have Disadvantage on Perception checks in bright light.

results.name: A random ally within 60ft is teleported to a random...
results.description: A random ally within 60ft is teleported to a random unoccupied point within 100ft of you.

results.name: Every other spellcaster within 60ft, friend or foe, loses...
results.description: Every other spellcaster within 60ft, friend or foe, loses their lowest level unspent spell slot.

results.name: Elemental imbalance
results.description: Elemental imbalance: for 1 day you have Resistance 10 to a random element (fire, cold or lightning) but take double damage from another, chosen by the GM.

results.name: Three illusory duplicates of you appear for 1 minute, as...
results.description: Three illusory duplicates of you appear for 1 minute, as mirror image.

results.name: You vanish and reappear in the same place 1d4 rounds later
results.description: You vanish and reappear in the same place 1d4 rounds later. To you, no time has passed.

results.name: Wild echo
results.description: Wild echo: the spell is cast a second time at a random target or point within range, chosen by the GM.

results.name: Far Realm tentacles fill a 20ft radius around you for 1...
results.description: Far Realm tentacles fill a 20ft radius around you for 1 minute. Each creature ending its turn there makes a Reflex save or is Grappled (others use your spell DC; you, DC 15).

results.name: A random creature within 30ft ages 1d10 years in an instant
results.description: A random creature within 30ft ages 1d10 years in an instant.

results.name: Your appearance is permanently transformed (the player and...
results.description: Your appearance is permanently transformed (the player and GM agree how); you are no longer recognisable as yourself.

results.name: A thunderous boom erupts from you
results.description: A thunderous boom erupts from you. You and every creature within 30ft make a Fortitude save or are Deafened for 1 hour (others use your spell DC; you, DC 15).

results.name: A random creature within 30ft must make a Fortitude save...
results.description: A random creature within 30ft must make a Fortitude save against your spell DC or turn into a harmless beast for 1 minute, as polymorph.

results.name: A spirit from the Shadowfell rides your body for 1 minute
results.description: A spirit from the Shadowfell rides your body for 1 minute: the GM controls you on each of your turns.

results.name: A tiny spirit of chaos attaches itself to you permanently
results.description: A tiny spirit of chaos attaches itself to you permanently. It is harmless, cannot be dismissed, and loudly comments on everything.

results.name: Something vast notices you
results.description: Something vast notices you: a god or patron takes an interest in you, and the GM decides what that means.

results.name: Your fortune sours
results.description: Your fortune sours: lose 1 Luck, and you cannot gain Luck for 1 day.

results.name: Chaos smiles on you
results.description: Chaos smiles on you: gain 2 Luck.

results.name: You are affected by fly for 10 minutes but cannot land; you...
results.description: You are affected by fly for 10 minutes but cannot land; you drift 10ft above the ground until it ends.

results.name: Every metal object within 10ft rusts and corrodes; mundane...
results.description: Every metal object within 10ft rusts and corrodes; mundane metal weapons and armour, yours included, are useless until repaired.

results.name: Life drains from everything around you
results.description: Life drains from everything around you: plants within 60ft wither, and every creature within 15ft, you included, takes 2d6 necrotic damage.

results.name: Raw power locks your muscles
results.description: Raw power locks your muscles: you are Stunned until the end of your next turn.

results.name: Make a Fortitude save, DC 15, or be Paralysed for 1 minute
results.description: Make a Fortitude save, DC 15, or be Paralysed for 1 minute. Repeat the save at the end of each of your turns to end it.

results.name: Bleeding power
results.description: Bleeding power: for 1 day, each spell you cast deals 1d4 force damage to you.

results.name: Stolen voice
results.description: Stolen voice: you cannot speak for 24 hours and so cannot cast spells with verbal components.

results.name: A howling wind from the Abyss pours from a crack in the air...
results.description: A howling wind from the Abyss pours from a crack in the air for 1 minute. Creatures within 30ft make a Fortitude save against your spell DC each round or are pushed 10ft away.

results.name: Null
results.description: Null: all magic within 30ft of you, your own included, is suppressed for 1 minute, as anti-magic shell.

results.name: Your skin hardens to a permanent metallic sheen
results.description: Your skin hardens to a permanent metallic sheen: +1 AC, but Disadvantage on Stealth checks in light.

results.name: You and a random creature within 30ft swap minds for 1...
results.description: You and a random creature within 30ft swap minds for 1 minute. Each controls the other's body.

results.name: A blinding flash
results.description: A blinding flash: you and every creature within 30ft make a Fortitude save or are Blinded for 1 minute (others use your spell DC; you, DC 15).

results.name: Scarred
results.description: Scarred: you cannot use Wild Surge again for 1 day.

results.name: Lingering chaos
results.description: Lingering chaos: the next three spells you cast each trigger a Corruption roll, as if you had used Wild Surge.

results.name: Corpses within 60ft stir and rise as hostile undead of...
results.description: Corpses within 60ft stir and rise as hostile undead of minimal threat for 1 minute.

results.name: Lost hour
results.description: Lost hour: you forget everything that happened in the last hour.

results.name: Hurled away
results.description: Hurled away: you vanish and reappear somewhere within 1d10 days' travel, chosen by the GM.

results.name: A crown of wild flame circles your head for 1 minute
results.description: A crown of wild flame circles your head for 1 minute. Your spells deal one extra damage die, but you take 1d6 fire damage at the start of each of your turns.

results.name: A small elemental bursts into being within 30ft and serves...
results.description: A small elemental bursts into being within 30ft and serves you for 1 minute, then turns hostile.

results.name: Chaos fire ignites on your body
results.description: Chaos fire ignites on your body: you take 2d6 fire damage at the start of each of your turns for 1 minute, or until you or an ally douse it.

results.name: Thorned vines erupt in a 20ft radius around you
results.description: Thorned vines erupt in a 20ft radius around you. You and every creature there make a Reflex save or are Restrained for 1 minute (others use your spell DC; you, DC 15).

results.name: A third eye opens permanently in your brow
results.description: A third eye opens permanently in your brow: Advantage on Perception checks that rely on sight, but Disadvantage on Persuasion checks with strangers who see it.

results.name: Every active spell within 30ft, friendly or hostile, ends...
results.description: Every active spell within 30ft, friendly or hostile, ends at once, as dispel magic.

results.name: Rift
results.description: Rift: a hostile minor extraplanar creature (Level up to half your level, GM chooses) tears through within 30ft.

results.name: Doomed
results.description: Doomed: you have Disadvantage on all saves for 1 hour.

results.name: You and every creature within 10ft are pulled into the...
results.description: You and every creature within 10ft are pulled into the Feywild for 1 hour, then returned to the same spot.

results.name: Time stutters
results.description: Time stutters: every creature within 30ft except you is Slowed for 1 minute.

results.name: A shard of chaos lodges in your mind permanently
results.description: A shard of chaos lodges in your mind permanently: gain a new compulsion or quirk (the player and GM agree on it).

results.name: Flames burst from your skin
results.description: Flames burst from your skin: you take 2d6 fire damage, then gain Resistance 10 to fire damage for 1 day.

results.name: Your shadow tears free and fights you as a hostile creature...
results.description: Your shadow tears free and fights you as a hostile creature for 1 minute. If it is destroyed, your shadow returns.

results.name: Raw entropy
results.description: Raw entropy: make a Fortitude save, DC 15. On a failure you drop to 0 HP; on a success you take 2d10 necrotic damage.

results.name: Chaos incarnate
results.description: Chaos incarnate: roll twice more on this table and apply both results, rerolling this result if it comes up again.
